_comment: F4: Case 1 (per-size Q_m helium) with the FISSION cascade source held
by mirror_production.  F1/F2 could not answer the question they were built
for: `cascade` also swaps the cascade source spectrum, and the fusion sheet
carries v_cascade 10 -> 20 and i_cascade 20 -> 50 -- parameters no design
column controls.  v_cascade is a direct void-nucleation lever, and doubling
it raised cavity density 100-1000x, swamping the He formulation entirely.
Here the ONLY difference from the S8 baseline is the He formulation (FUSION He rate (10 appm/dpa)).
This is a diagnostic, not a fusion prediction.
